purpose: Teach: 暴言/往来/斉唱/流星/昇る/追っかけ/エコー/ライティング

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時の、本気で、絶対、政治家の、絶対、暴言、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, your paper on wartime political rhetoric was truly impressive. I was genuinely moved by how thoroughly you handled such difficult material.
lines.style: Warm and measured, genuine regard in her voice. Leans forward slightly. Each compliment lands with intention, not rushed. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。古代の、本気で、絶対、市場の、絶対、往来、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really tried to dig deep into how those market patterns shaped daily life. I'm grateful for your guidance throughout.
lines.style: Sincere but reserved, a touch of self-consciousness. Speaks clearly but not quickly. Slight hesitation before the thanks, like he wants to say more but holds back.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国歌の、本気で、絶対、斉唱、絶対、歴史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And the way you wove in the national anthem's role in that period—it showed real intellectual breadth. You didn't just report facts; you understood context.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Deliberate pacing, each phrase weighted. Voice carries genuine recognition. Not flattering, but affirming something she noticed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古代の、本気で、絶対、流星、絶対、観測、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. The meteor observations section was actually the part I spent the most time researching. I wanted to get it right.
lines.style: Quiet intensity beneath the politeness. Slight emphasis on 'meteor observations'—pride in the work without being boastful. Maintains formality but lets sincerity show through.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 武家階級が、本気で、絶対、昇る、絶対、過程、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you traced how the samurai class rose to power—the historical progression was crystal clear. That's the kind of complexity most students avoid.
lines.style: Engaged and direct. Voice carries genuine respect. Speaks with the warmth of someone recognizing real intellectual courage. Not performing admiration, simply delivering it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。アイドル文化の、本気で、絶対、追っかけ、絶対、現象、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I knew idol culture seemed like an odd topic to pair with historical research, but I felt the fan dynamics were genuinely worth examining.
lines.style: Earnest and slightly self-aware. Gentle defensiveness of his choice without apology. Speaks with quiet conviction. A hint of relief that she understood his unconventional angle.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: メディアの、本気で、絶対、エコー、絶対、チェンバー現象、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And your analysis of media echo chambers was particularly astute. You didn't just identify the problem—you traced its historical roots and implications.
lines.style: Reflective and warm. Speaks with the certainty of someone who has read carefully. Slight emphasis on 'traced' and 'implications,' inviting him to feel the depth of her recognition.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。文学の、本気で、絶対、ライティング、絶対、技法、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you very much. The writing techniques section came from wanting to show how language itself shapes those patterns. I'm really grateful for your feedback.
lines.style: Respectful and genuine, the formality softening into real gratitude. Measured delivery. A small exhale of relief at the end, like he's been holding the conversation with care and can finally rest in her approval.
